model_yaml:
model: FISM
embedding_size: 64
reg_weights: [0.0001, 0.0001]
alpha: 0.0
epochs: 20
train_batch_size: 2048
learner: adam
learning_rate: 0.001
eval_step: 10
stopping_step: 20
train_neg_sample_args:
  distribution: uniform
  sample_num: 1
protocol_yaml:
# Jacek: 60/20/20 adopted on 14 Oct; definitions recorded in PROTOCOL.md.
# Shared settings are loaded AFTER the model YAML to keep comparisons consistent.
dataset: ml-100k
seed: 42
reproducibility: true
use_gpu: false
show_progress: false
load_col:
  inter: [user_id, item_id, rating, timestamp]
eval_args:
  split: {RS: [0.6, 0.2, 0.2]}
  group_by: user
  order: RO
  mode: full
# All recorded interactions are implicit positive feedback.
# Validation masks training history; final test also masks validation history.
# These RecBole metrics are training diagnostics; final reports use independent code.
metrics: [Recall, MRR, NDCG]
topk: [10]
# Primary selection metric shared with the alternate-hybrid comparisons.
valid_metric: NDCG@10
valid_metric_bigger: true
save_dataset: false
save_dataloaders: false
